objects.name: Splunk security advisory (AV26-586) – Update 1
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-586 Date: June 10, 2026 Update: June 18, 2026 On June 10, 2026, Splunk published security advisories to address vulnerabilities in the following products: Splunk SOAR – versions prior to 8.5.0 Splunk Enterprise – multiple versions and platforms Splunk Cloud Platform – multiple versions and platforms Update 1 On June 18, 2026, Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) added CVE-2026-20253 to their Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Database. Splunk Security Advisories CISA KEV: CVE-2026-20253
